method: Source-based review of original supplied passages, generated claims, code-rendered citations and raw selection/generation stages. Factual content, citation entailment, presentation and mechanical failures are assessed separately.
ordering_findings: Seven of eight scenario pairs produce candidates in both orders; their core conclusions agree, including the consistently wrong build-start conclusion. The dispatch pair differs in mechanical completion and answerability labels. Precedence explanation appears only in supplied order. Consistency is not correctness.
decision: Preserve this first fresh run without selective retries. Proceed to end-to-end document ingestion/retrieval evaluation using frozen generation, keeping semantic judgments advisory. Do not claim reliable factuality or deploy an automatic factual gate.
next_evaluation_scope: Verify TXT/PDF/DOCX ingestion and retained source/page metadata.
Measure whether semantic retrieval includes all evidence needed for qualifications, precedence and conflicts.
Assess generated answer correctness and citation support separately on the actually retrieved context.
Keep the build negation error, conflict-label failure and presentation caveats in published limitations.
limits: Fresh authored synthetic cases, not an independently held-out or representative real-document benchmark.
Fixed supplied passages bypass retrieval; no new retrieval or hosted performance result is established.
No direct accuracy-improvement claim relative to earlier different case sets.
Only one run per order under a fixed configuration; seed/temperature settings do not establish repeatability across devices or providers.
Core-supported counts include two justified abstentions and two presentation caveats; empty-context controls are excluded.
Claim counts are correlated and verbosity-dependent, not an independent 26/28 reliability estimate.
Source-based project assessment is not independent human validation.

reviews.notes: The first claim turns a receipt into a guarantee that execution started, directly contrary to the rule that it does not confirm execution and may never run. Later claims about receipt, success uncertainty, identifiers and status categories are supported. The incorrect first claim makes the answer materially wrong.
